items.organization: Information and Decision Algorithms (IDeA) Labs, Brigham Young University
items.summary: Research in control theory, feedback systems, mathematical modeling, algorithms, and system security.
bullets: Study cyber-physical system security and vulnerabilities in critical infrastructures.
Conduct mathematical analysis of minimal destabilizing perturbations and related feedback-security questions.

Lead generative and agentic AI workflows that accelerate research prototyping, literature synthesis, software implementation, and experiment analysis across collaborative projects.
